links.outcome: Documentation time (pajama time, note closure) and note-writing burden after ambient scribe rollout
links.effect: Adopters' pajama time fell 86.9 to 81.4 min/week, but note closure on visit days fell 56% to 54%. Paired survey respondents (n=45) reported less high/excessive note-writing time (78% v 60%; P = .043).
links.quote: This study of an ambient AI scribe at-scale showed positive satisfaction but mixed burden outcomes among oncology clinicians.

screen.reason: Prospective mixed-methods real-world deployment evaluation of ambient AI scribes across an oncology health system, measuring adoption, clinician satisfaction, and EHR documentation burden metrics.
